description: This Java source file defines the class 'DefinitionManager', a GUI component responsible for managing ECU definition files in the RomRaider application. It provides functionality for adding, removing, reordering, and saving the list of definition files through a Swing-based user interface.

classes.name: DefinitionManager
classes.description: A Swing JFrame class providing a UI to manage ECU definition files, allowing users to add, remove, reorder, and save their file list.

methods.name: DefinitionManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GUI, settings, and event listeners.

methods.name: initSettings
methods.description: Initializes the list of definition files from saved settings.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles button click events for cancel, save, apply, move up/down, add, remove, and undo actions.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Saves the current list of definition files to persistent settings.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Opens a file chooser dialog to add a new ECU definition file to the list.

methods.name: moveSelection
methods.description: Reorders the selected file up or down in the list.

methods.name: removeSelection
methods.description: Removes the selected file from the list.

methods.name: updateListModel
methods.description: Refreshes the list display with the current fileNames vector.
